headline: Result Update

highlights: (NSE Ltd.) Important Data • National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) reported its first results since listing: consolidated PAT of ₹2,578crs, up 22.9% YoY (−17.4% QoQ).

Options market share (68%) is the watch-point. • Capital & Corporate Actions: H1FY27 PAT was ₹5,698crs; board approved sale of up to 40% of National Coal Exchange; SEBI settlement behind. • We recommend to HOLD the stock at current price with an exit multiple of 40x FY28E EPS.
Q1 data connectivity was ₹258crs and rack/connectivity income rose again this quarter. ● Cost Base: Total expenses of ₹1,161crs (−51% YoY), broadly flat QoQ (₹1,129crs).

The YoY drop is almost entirely the ₹1,297crs SEBI settlement provision booked in Q2FY26. ● Reported vs Underlying: Reported EBITDA +107% YoY to ₹3,079crs; normalised Q2FY26 EBITDA was ₹2,782crs, so underlying growth is ~11%.
valuation: Options market share (68%) is the watch-point. • Capital & Corporate Actions: H1FY27 PAT was ₹5,698crs; board approved sale of up to 40% of National Coal Exchange; SEBI settlement behind. • We recommend to HOLD the stock at current price with an exit multiple of 40x FY28E EPS.

Risks: derivatives regulation (expiry, lot size), options market-share loss, a falling volume cycle and regulatory/litigation.
